2.name: And the Burning Heart
2.overview: When the Librarians are sent to an international boarding school to investigate an outbreak of inexplicable rage, they encounter a mysterious man claiming to be the legendary wizard Merlin. Together, the group must overcome their own anger and uncover the source of the magic before time runs out.

2.name: And the Tethered Wish
2.overview: A freed genie is granting wishes across Belgrade, leaving chaos in his wake. The Librarians must return the genie to his bottle before his magic spirals out of control ... a task that proves difficult when Vikram makes a hasty wish.

2.name: And the Vanishing Bankers
2.overview: The Librarians discover a sinister new incarnation of Peter Pan is recruiting the next generation of Lost Boys. When Charlie becomes one of his captives, the team must venture into a twisted version of Neverland.

2.name: And the Recipe for Disaster
2.overview: When Connor is bewitched by a "smell spell" and becomes a contestant on a cooking competition show, the Librarians must break the enchantment by defeating the show's hosts.

2.name: And the Red Rock
2.overview: The Librarians discover that the charming young scientist Lysa is dating is actually the Red Rock, a superhero battling a crime wave across Belgrade.

2.name: And Descartes' Dilemma
2.overview: While on a mission to recover the missing bracelets of Castor and Pollux, the Librarians accidentally swap bodies with one another.

2.name: And the Monkey's Paw
2.overview: While pursuing a Monkey's Paw, the Librarians become trapped in a strange hotel shrouded in a mysterious fog. To escape, the team must confront past traumas, and, in the process, learn the difference between what they wish for and what they truly need.

2.name: And the Last Resort
2.overview: The Librarians investigate an magical ley line at a 200-year-old resort known for its venerable puppet theater. Their attempt to turn the mission into a vacation is thwarted when they uncover a sentient puppet's evil scheme to destroy the resort.

2.name: And the Toy Phone
2.overview: While the rest of the team is away on a Library retreat, Charlie receives a call on a mysterious toy phone from a child trapped in a haunted house. To save the child, Charlie must enlist the help of original Librarians Jacob Stone and Cassandra Cillian.

2.name: And the Heart of a Librarian
2.overview: The Librarians must help Vikram's long-lost love Anya unravel a mystery from the past -- through letters sent across time -- before the magical events she faces in the Victorian era ripple forward with consequences for the future.

2.name: And What Dreams May Come
2.overview: A distress call from Merlin leads the Librarians to a town where the entire population has mysteriously fallen asleep. As they search for the magical artifact behind the enchantment, the team must confront their darkest nightmares brought vividly to life.

2.name: And the Camelot Conundrum
2.overview: The Librarians face their deadliest mission yet when a power-hungry Merlin returns to Camelot, determined to rewrite both the past and the future. Now, the team must stop the formidable wizard and prevent the collapse of time itself -- or die trying.

overview: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The legendary wizard Merlin enters the picture as a powerful and unpredictable force, waking up ancient and unstable magic that threatens the modern world. Vikram faces deep emotional trials, including magical correspondence across centuries that connects him to his past love, Anya, creating high-stakes tension between past eras and the present. Vikram's team of specialists—including Lysa, Connor, and Charlie—work together to track down supernatural artifacts and fix reality-altering mistakes.
